app.name: Tekó
app.tagline: Brazilian tax law, as of the right date
app.description: Open-source assistant that answers questions about Brazilian tax law, citing the source and the wording in force on the reference date. Under construction.

common.disclaimer: A research aid; not professional advice.
common.license: Open source under the MIT license.

landing.title: Tax law, in the wording that applied on your date.
landing.lead: Tekó is an open-source assistant for questions about Brazilian tax law. Every answer will be given for a tax period or reference date and will cite the provision and the version it used.

referenceDate.title: Reference date first
referenceDate.body: You set the tax period (for example, 03/2024) and the answer uses the wording in force at that time. If the rule changed within the period, Tekó tells you.

citations.title: Verifiable citations
citations.body: Every statement points to the provision, version and validity interval it relied on, with a link to the official source.

coverage.title: Declared coverage
coverage.body: Tekó states which rules and periods it knows. Outside that coverage, it declines instead of guessing.

projectStatus.title: Project status
projectStatus.body: We are laying the foundation: repository, contracts shared by the front end and the API, and this page. The assistant does not answer questions yet.
projectStatus.scope: The planned initial corpus covers the SPED guides and the ICMS legislation of the state of Goiás.
